faq_heading: Homes near Heath Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Heath Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Delta School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Heath Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Heath Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Heath Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Seaquam Secondary (0.8 km south-east), Chalmers Elementary (0.8 km north) and Cougar Canyon Elementary (0.9 km south-east).

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Heath Elementary

21 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Heath Elementary in a straight line (15 elementary, 6 secondary; 1 independent). The closest is Seaquam Secondary, 0.8 km away, and the farthest on this list is Kennedy Trail Elementary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Chalmers Elementary (0.8 km); the nearest independent school is Khalsa School Newton (2.1 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Chalmers Elementary (0.8 km). Other elementary schools close by: Chalmers Elementary (0.8 km north), Cougar Canyon Elementary (0.9 km south-east), Sunshine Hills Elementary (0.9 km south), Jarvis Traditional Elementary (1.5 km north-east), Cougar Creek Elementary (1.8 km east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Chalmers Elementary, 0.8 km north of Heath Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Heath Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Delta school finder. A home a few blocks from Heath Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Heath Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.
Look at Chalmers Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 0.8 km north of Heath Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
